summary: Latency-sensitive smoke pass on Kayum Fabric ERP customer-master + reports overhaul. Backend endpoints for customers-master, mill-purchases, fabric-movement, overdue all return 200 with correct shape and firm isolation. Frontend Add Customer modal on /customers, Reports tabs (monthly-sales, mill-purchases, fabric-movement, overdue), and NewBill customer-master datalist all render and function without blocking errors.
passed: Auth: login salar@kayum.com and hakayum@kayum.com both return JWTs; /api/auth/me returns firm scoping
POST /api/customers-master (salar) creates customer with all fields (name, address, phone, gst_number, credit_period_days, firm_id) → 200
POST /api/customers-master duplicate for same firm → 400 'Customer already exists in this firm'
POST /api/customers-master missing name → 422 pydantic validation error
GET /api/customers-master (salar) returns 1 customer created via master; (hakayum) returns 0 → firm isolation verified
GET /api/customers (salar) returns 200 with existing ledger customers (TestCo Traders, Haji miyan, etc.)
GET /api/reports/mill-purchases returns list of line items with fields mill_name, fabric_name, shade_no, fabric_count, meters, rate, bill_number, bill_date, firm_name (3 rows for salar)
GET /api/reports/fabric-movement returns list with fabric_name, mill_name, shade_no, current_stock, sold_meters, movement, firm_name (3 rows, sorted by sold desc — 'fast' first)
GET /api/reports/overdue returns [] with 200 (no overdue bills in current data — empty state acceptable per spec)
GET /api/reports/overdue for hakayum (no data) returns [] with 200 — no errors on empty data

Frontend /customers: [data-testid=add-customer-button] opens modal; all fields (customer-name-input, customer-address-input, customer-phone-input, customer-gst-input, customer-credit-period-input) present; firm select works; submit adds row to customers-table with 'New' status badge
Frontend /reports: all 4 tabs (monthly-sales, mill-purchases, fabric-movement, overdue) switch without report-error content; no uncaught exceptions
Frontend report-mill-purchases-table headers verified: MILL / FABRIC / SHADE / COUNT / METERS / RATE / BILL NO. / DATE / FIRM — data rows populated
Frontend report-fabric-movement-table headers verified: FABRIC / MILL / SHADE / TOTAL SOLD (M) / IN STOCK / MOVEMENT / FIRM — data rows populated
Frontend /bills/new: #customer-master-list datalist present in DOM with 2 options (customers fetched from /api/customers-master)

failed.issue: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' in Reports render, and 'span cannot be a child of option' hydration warning
failed.evidence: Console errors captured during /reports navigation. Non-blocking — tables still render correctly.

failed.issue: No overdue bills exist in current dataset, so red-row rendering could not be visually verified. Empty state returned (200 []). Per spec, empty is acceptable, but red highlight rendering path was not exercised.
failed.evidence: GET /api/reports/overdue returned [] for both firms; overdue-table testid not present in DOM.
